name: Motorcomm Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Motorcomm Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and industrialization of high-speed wired network communication chips in China. It offers ethernet physical layer chips, including consumption grade single- and multi-port PHY, as well as industrial grade single- and multi-port PHY chips. It also provides automotive ethernet PHY layer chips, switch chips, and ethernet NIC chips. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
